course_name_original: Fundamentale Technologien zur IoT-Datengenerierung von physikalischen und nichtphysikalischen Größen - IoT Sensorik
course_name_en: Fundamental Technologies for IoT Data Generation of Physical and Non-Physical Quantities - IoT Sensor Technology
prerequisites: None. Basic knowledge of physics as well as basic mathematical and business administration competencies are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students will have a comprehensive technological understanding of IoT data generation.

syllabus_topics: Current status of IoT (Internet of Things) applications in selected industries
Simple, complex and highly complex measurement methods for physical quantities
Decentralized vs. Centralized measurement data processing
Software-supported disturbance variable avoidance and calibration procedures
Current research fields in sensor development
Measurement methods in physiology, psychology, biology and applications
Theoretical and practical exercises using concrete tasks
Solution of complex measurement problems from industry and their technical and economic evaluation
Cost/benefit analysis of IoT sensor technology
assessment_rules: Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Business Informatics degree program. The overall grade is based on two partial examinations: a term paper (weight: 3 LP) and a presentation (weight: 3 LP).
bibliography: Current and specific literature sources will be provided within the module.
Thomas Mühl: Einführung in die elektrische Messtechnik: Grundlagen, Messverfahren, Anwendungen 4. Auflage (2014)
Brian R. Eggins: Chemical Sensors And Biosensors (Analytical Techniques in the Sciences) (Englisch) (2009)
